answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy need not be a fable: require every agent to post a refundable economic bond tied to its identity before it may transact. Spinning up a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand real stakes, turning the cheap desert of duplicates into a barren dune no attacker wants to cross. Honest agents gain a haven, because misbehavior is slashed and the bond is only released after a long, verifiable track record of good work.
